author: Camemes
body:
Ladies and Gentlemen! I present to you...

The shanky shack!! Built by myself and Bikingmadman

It is a tactical outpost/summer getaway for you to either defend or relax depending on your intentions!

Just something a little fun to build on any map, all you have to do is build a little shack with a military and a leisure purpose and comment below! :)

here is my shanky shack...



Or view it on imgur: http://imgur.com/dbDgZER
